notes: No section headers are posted; the first group lists the Objective, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Squadron Assignments, Your Insight Serves You Well & Staging Areas and Insurrection & Aim High, read as the starting cards; all count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.

The description claims the deck went 4-0 at the Montreal DPC (1st after 8 games) and 2-1 at DragonCon (8th place). The wiki has no page for a 2001 Montreal DPC event or for 2001 DragonCon, so the deck stays a general DeckTech list.
